meta.title: Roda o VI? Check if your PC can handle the port
meta.description: See whether your PC can handle the community-made PC port of GTA VI. Nothing to download: the test runs in your browser.

hero.chip2: Runs in your browser, in 10 seconds
hero.h1: Can your PC run GTA VI?
hero.lead: The test reads your graphics card through the browser and compares it with the PCs the community has used to run ports of the leaked build.

meter.label: Estimated fps on the port
meter.title: Gauge of estimated fps on the port
meter.noOpen: Your card probably won't start the ports

strip.s1: PS5 and Xbox Series. Rockstar hasn't said anything about PC yet.

pc.sub: We filled in what we could detect. Browsers don't reveal your CPU model or how much RAM you have, so check and adjust.
pc.detGpu: Click Test my PC to detect it.
pc.detCpu: Pick your model from the list.
pc.gpuUnknown: We don't recognize "{x}". Pick it from the list.
pc.gpuNone: Your browser didn't reveal the card. Pick it from the list.
pc.cpuThreads: Your processor has {t} threads. Pick the model for a more accurate result.

res.sub: Two readings: how your PC does on the community ports today, and an estimate for when the official PC version comes out.
res.portHint: Click Test my PC above, or pick your parts from the list.
res.pct: Compatibility with the best tested PC
res.offH: Official PC version, when it ships
res.offHint: We compare your card with the PS5's, the console the game runs on today.
res.offNote: Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version or its requirements.

news.sub: The ports change every day. News comes from PortWatch VI.

band.t: Vice City hasn't reached PC yet.
band.s: But the community is close: the best port already tops 20 fps. See who's ahead.

rank.sub: Most advanced first. Numbers are reported by the groups themselves and change with every build.
rank.src: Source: PortWatch VI. Most numbers haven't been independently verified.

foot.legal: Fan-made, not affiliated with Rockstar Games, Take-Two or Microsoft. Estimates use relative GPU performance and community-reported tests. It's for curiosity, not a guarantee.
foot.credit: Inspired by PortWatch VI by 4lwayz, which has tracked the ports from the start. News and ranking come from there.
foot.code: Open source on GitHub. Put the test on your site.

score: Your PC's compatibility with the best tested PC
